feature: Shopping for all decks v2 (handoff design_handoff_the99_all_decks_cart_v2; plan 2026-10-28-all-decks-cart-v2.md)
note: PR 8 rows: the chassis frame, search and sort in the three views that exist today. PR 4 rows: By card's row facts (the `+N` pill, an opened list, a cut lone name with `more`, a row with nothing owned); the `more` row needs a deck whose name is too wide for its cell on its own (the board's fixture is 43 characters; at 390 the need cell is about 180px). PR 5 rows: By deck's open group (its own column header with `This deck · also` on desktop, the `DECK` line on a phone, `also` naming only the other decks, a `+N` pill and an opened list); the groups start folded, so each row opens the first. PR 6 rows: By friend's panels (By friend's column header with `Spare` on desktop, the head's `N cards · N spares`, the row's need, spare and own facts, the Ask or its status above the tag, a folded panel, and on desktop the open header stuck to the list box top while its rows scroll); they need a friend with a spare of a selected line, and the status row a request already sent. The single-spare panel (`1 card · 1 spare`) and the spare key while the read is out are proved in `cart-by-friend.test.tsx`, since neither holds still on a live account. PR 7 rows: the reading, empty and failed states, staged by holding or answering `/api/friend-spares` (a read held 8s draws Loading A to D; an empty answer draws Empty-One B; a 500 draws addendum R2's failed read: the toast in By card and By deck, the dashed block with Try again in By friend). Empty-One C (no friends yet) needs an account with no friends, decided on the server: it is photographed by the companion inventory `all-decks-cart-v2-no-friends.json`, run on an account with none, and it and the said-once rule across view switches are proved in `cart-by-friend.test.tsx`. PR 9 rows: the Friend and Owned filters (the desktop panels, the phone Filters sheet, each filter carried across the views, a filter's no match, the Friend trigger reading and after a failed read); a named friend's filter, an unknown id dropped from `?friend` and the trigger absent with no spare are proved in `cart-by-friend.test.tsx`, since they need a known fixture friend. PR 10 (close-out): `shares` lists the nine controls the three views share, and each row names the one its photograph is about in `binding` (`pnpm check:shared`). The By friend panel rows friend-rest, friend-stuck, friend-folded and friend-status, and the desktop Friend panel, need an account with a friend holding a spare of a selected line; reading-friend and none-friend need only a friend, since they hold or empty the spares read; local-dev held no `friend_links` row at all on 2026-10-28, so on it those cells draw Empty-One C instead and do not reach (the close-out records them). Needs a server with ALL_DECKS_CART_ENABLED=true and an account whose decks are missing cards (a pull:staging copy of Hugh's).

shares.note: The chassis (search, Friend, Owned, sort, chips, result line) for all three views: `CartView` renders it once over whichever view is on, so every chassis and filter row names cart-view.tsx.
The phone's Filters sheet (plan A6), opened from the chassis's Filters button for every view, so its row names cart-chassis.tsx.
The desktop column header: By card's and By friend's are drawn by `CartView`, By deck's by each group (`CartDeckGroup`).

The one v2 row every view draws. By deck renders it as-is from `CartDeckGroup`; By card (`CartCardLine`) and By friend (`CartFriendLine`) render it through wrappers in cart-line.tsx itself, which is why their rows check `CartFact` and `CartFriendLine` instead.
One labelled fact (need, spare, own; the `+N` / `more` / `less` pill and the opened list). `CartFactsRow` in cart-line.tsx renders it for every view.
By friend's row: `CartFactsRow` with the Ask above the tag, rendered by each friend panel.
The app's dashed empty-state block, as By friend's none, no-friends and failed blocks draw it.

The Ask, or the Requested / Accepted / Declined status in its place, shared with the deck's spares sheet. By friend's panel renders it into `CartFriendLine`'s ask slot, so the status row names cart-by-friend.tsx.
The shared social toast that says a failed spares read once in By card and By deck (addendum R2 B2).
